ai_summary.key_headline: Lions of Mesopotamia Target Haaland Containment Strategy

iraq.philosophy: Disciplined mid-block with a focal point target man.

norway.philosophy: Direct possession targeting Haaland's central runs.

tactical_insights: Iraq will deploy a double-pivot screen to restrict service to Erling Haaland in the penalty area.
Norway's wings will try to overlap and cross frequently to exploit Iraq's height disadvantage in defense.
Ali Jasim's pace on the counter will be Iraq's primary outlet to bypass Norway's high defensive line.
